# harfbuzz_ex v1.2.0 - Table of Contents

Elixir binding for Harfbuzz using Rustybuzz as NIF, with RustlerPrecompiled

## Modules

- [HarfbuzzEx](https://harfbuzz-ex.hexdocs.pm/HarfbuzzEx.md): Elixir wrapper for Rust `rustybuzz` crate for OpenType shaping.
- [HarfbuzzEx.Pool](https://harfbuzz-ex.hexdocs.pm/HarfbuzzEx.Pool.md): A NimblePool for concurrent Harfbuzz text shaping.

- [HarfbuzzEx.Shaper.Glyph](https://harfbuzz-ex.hexdocs.pm/HarfbuzzEx.Shaper.Glyph.md): Represents a shaped glyph.
